findings.message: net PE has no pins
findings.waived_by: designer: PE exists only off-board (box, ring, cover, EGC splice); no PCB copper by design (REQ-4, NEC 250.148(B)). The net is declared so the LINE-PE barrier reaches intent.yaml.

findings.message: K1 (G5RL-1A-E-TV8 DC5): current on L_IN through pin 13 (set i_through= if the part carries less) 15 vs rating 16 (94%) — above 80% derating
findings.waived_by: designer: Relay contacts at 15 A vs 16 A (94 %): UL E41643 lists 16 A general use at 40 C (50k ops) and VDE lists 16 A at 85 C. 15 A is the branch-breaker ceiling, not a continuous load; continuous loads are limited to 12 A = 75 % (REQ-5, calc relay_contact_continuous_ratio). Verified by T-OL and T-HEAT.

findings.message: D10 (green): current on GND through pin 1 (set i_through= if the part carries less) 0.39 vs rating 0.025 (1560%) — exceeds rating
findings.waived_by: designer: Checker applies the whole net current to every series-category pin on the net, but these parts are in shunt: flyback diodes D1-D4 carry only the 93 mA coil current for a few ms at release (I_FM 300 mA); LEDs D5-D10 carry 2.3 mA (25 mA rating); D12 carries the < 0.1 mA pump current (200 mA rating).

findings.message: J2 (2606-3102/020-000): custom footprint custom:WAGO_2606-3102_020-000 must be drawn and reviewed
findings.waived_by: designer: No KiCad library footprint exists for WAGO 2606-3102/020-000. Geometry from the WAGO data sheet p.1 drawing (drill 2.0 +0.1 mm, pole 2 at +7.5/+12.5 mm, body 17.85 x 24 mm); lever side to be checked against WAGO CAD before layout freeze.

findings.message: external net L_IN declares threat 'surge' but has no tvs/mov on it
findings.waived_by: designer: No MOV/TVS on mains by design (DESIGN.md C-11): insulation is coordinated for OVC II (1.5 kV transient; relay 10 kV impulse coil-contact, PCB 8 mm reinforced, 6.4 mm functional). An MOV ages and is a fire source in a closed unlisted box; a listed Type 2 SPD at the panel is recommended (Q-9). Verified by T-SURGE.

findings.message: external net L_IN declares threat 'overcurrent' but has no fuse/ptc on it
findings.waived_by: designer: The upstream branch breaker (<= 15 A, REQ-2) is the single overcurrent device; every element on these nets is rated >= 15 A at temperature (terminals 31 A, relays 16 A, copper 7.5 mm x 2 layers x 2 oz with 1.4x I2t margin at 2 kA; calcs mains_*). A fuse inside a closed box is not serviceable (C-9).

findings.message: H10: mitigated only procedurally (label: relays are not a disconnecting means; lock out at the breaker)
findings.waived_by: designer: Relays are not a disconnecting means; locking out the branch breaker is the only correct mitigation.

findings.message: H15: mitigated only procedurally (the motor's own overload protection (NEC 430); 1/2 hp relay rating; contactor for larger motors)
findings.waived_by: designer: Motor overload protection belongs to the load (NEC 430), outside this board; REQ-5 limits motors to 1/2 hp.

findings.message: Q-1 is BLOCKING and unanswered: Certification path: who evaluates (AHJ field evaluation) and who installs (licensed electrician) this unlisted assembly? If neither is acceptable, buy listed products (alternative A5).
Q-2 is BLOCKING and unanswered: Confirm 4 channels (6 do not fit a 4-11/16 in box; they need a 6 x 6 x 4 in enclosure).
Q-3 is BLOCKING and unanswered: Confirm the branch circuit is <= 15 A (20 A needs per-channel fuses or 20 A relays).

Q-4 is BLOCKING and unanswered: Load list: any heaters, pumps, compressors or life-safety loads that are unsafe if a contact welds? Motors cycled more than about 5 times a day should drive a contactor.
Q-5 is BLOCKING and unanswered: Confirm surface mounting (flush mounting in an insulated wall overheats the box).
Q-6 is BLOCKING and unanswered: Insulating SELV cover MP1: confirm material and fixing, and AHJ acceptance as the NEC 725.136(B) barrier.
